uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

880-7885-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-7885-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1671-2645-3430-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
1671-2645-3430-4644.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

978-2292--5.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with persist
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

323-1981-2415-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

1116-2738-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sek'Kuar, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2738-4871-6255-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Zahur, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

225-4365-4772-6441-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2034-2308-7574.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2308-7574.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Sultai Flayer triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

275-2604-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Ugin, the Ineffable.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7726.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Virtuous Variant.
When Virtuous Variant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Virtuous Variant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

539-4657-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Doc Samson.
Repeat.

2724-3080-4608-5163.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five enchantments.
2724-3080-4608-5163.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Roon of the Hidden Realm by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling and returning (at end step) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

2438-4302-4509.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another Angel.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1453-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6965-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

240-5147-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

252-1575-4050-5776.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
As the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Repeat.
252-1575-4050-5776.notes: The combo can instead by started by sacrificing an untapped noncreature Food to its own ability. This will replace step 1 for the first iteration and add {2} to the mana needed. After the first iteration, follow the steps above as normal.

997-6887-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
997-6887-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, The Skullspore Nexus and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1409-2499-4716.description:
Activate Prosperous Innkeeper by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Prosperous Innkeeper enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Prosperous Innkeeper.
Resolve both Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3652-4053-5330-6989.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

141-997-6814.description:
Cast Abnormal Endurance by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Abnormal Endurance, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Abnormal Endurance.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

3649-5904-5940.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
3649-5904-5940.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Adric by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying {1}{R}{R}, choosing its first mode, copying Etrata's trigger.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

60-6452.manaNeeded: {U/R}{U/R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
60-6452.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana value 4 or less.
60-6452.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
If Adaptive Training Post had two charge counters on it, it triggers, putting a charge counter on it.
Holding priority, activate Adaptive Training Post by removing three charge counters from it, copying the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn.
Cast Expansion by paying its mana cost, targeting the spell cast in step 1.
Adaptive Training Post triggers, copying Expansion, with the copy targeting the original Expansion.
Resolve the copy of Expansion, copying the original Expansion, with the copy targeting the original Expansion.
Repeat step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1305-4222-4417-6674.easyPrerequisites: Rydia does not have summoning sickness.
974-1305-4222-4417-6674.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Rydia by paying {5} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. As There and Back Again enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from There and Back Again.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering its ability, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {6}{U}{B}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Rydia.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and is modified

1029-5028-5845.description:
Activate Orochi Merge-Keeper by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Orochi Merge-Keeper.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5845.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

56-4054-5256-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4054-5256-6255.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Zahur triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
56-4054-5256-6255.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

643-4094-4508-5880.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
You control another nonland permanent.
643-4094-4508-5880.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

1263-2018-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Bloodsoaked Champion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 5, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2558-4659-5687-5690.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sword of the Meek, adding {C}{C}.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Ruination Guide, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Repeat.

3966-5755.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3966-5755.description:
Gain life.
Enduring Tenacity triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-2511-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-2511-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

56-2034-5695.description:
Cast Infested Thrinax by paying {3}{B}{G}.
When Infested Thrinax enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Saproling creature tokens when a nontoken creature you control dies.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hogaak, adding {C}{C}.
When Hogaak dies, Infested Thrinax triggers, creating eight 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by tapping seven Saprolings.
Repeat from step 3.

3220-3240-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {B}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature token dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1061-4844-5350.notablePrerequisites: You have the city's blessing and/or control at least nine permanents.
1061-4844-5350.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Admiral Brass triggers, returning Timestream Navigator from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it, and giving it haste.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library from the battlefield, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cellar Door by paying {3} and tapping it, searching your library for Timestream Navigator, putting it into your graveyard and creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each turn.

413-575-4180.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional nontoken creature.
413-575-4180.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 creature due to Living Lands.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

914-1849-3036.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1849-3036.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

1506-1636-3496.notablePrerequisites: Burrning Anger in hand.A player controls a nontoken creature with toughness less than or equal to Dread Slaver's power.
1506-1636-3496.description:
Cast Burning Anger by paying {4}{R}, targeting Dread Slaver.
Activate Dread Slaver by tapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any creature with toughness less than or equal to Dread Slaver's power.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Dread Slaver triggers, returning the creature to the battlefield from its owner's graveyard.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

814-1651-2034-3094.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-1651-2034-3094.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Soldiers, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1874-2034-2308.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-2034-2308.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Ajani's Welcome trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2689-3173-3368-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power seven or greater.
2689-3173-3368-4050.description:
Cast Fling by paying {1}{R} and sacrificing a creature you control with power seven or greater.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Fling and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Fling copy, causing you to create at least seven 3/1 Elemental Shaman creature tokens with haste due to Hostility.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Elemental Shamans, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Hostility, adding {R}.
Hostility dies, shuffling itself into your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Fling and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Fling copy, dealing at least seven damage to any target.
Repeat from step 8.

1953-2429-4231-4891.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause Atsushi to die.
1953-2429-4231-4891.description:
Kill Atsushi.
Atsushi triggers, creating three Food tokens, three Clue tokens and three Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr artifact creature token and causing all tokens you control to become Treasure tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Revel in Riches triggers, causing you to win the game.

618-957-2556.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall with haste.
The token copy of Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
